findings.fix: Record a process/session-scoped release duty before admitted TX can reach RPC; configuration alone grants no duty. Ordinary shutdown/workspace/disable cleanup sends RX only for that duty. Explicit Stop retains unconditional emergency RX. Retain pending/uncertain release until a matching RX acknowledgment after the send retires; block new output while sending/releasing/uncertain. Validate the complete action bundle before TX and recheck retirement after asynchronous text as well as TX, preventing later actions after Stop/context changes. Snapshot exposes release-required/uncertain state.
findings.tests: Six new cases cover eight unowned lifecycle/config combinations, admitted TX followed by failed RX/retry, blocked output during uncertain release, pending TX shutdown and late final release, explicit Stop without prior ownership, pending text workspace retirement preventing the next TX, and invalid later action preventing partial output. Existing failed-TX, disable/Stop during TX, receive/recovery and disabled-external-I/O controls retained.
findings.verification: New unowned matrix failed before the fix. `XLOG_PORTABLE_ONLY=1 swift test --scratch-path .build/prototype-tests --no-parallel --filter 'LiveFldigiBridge|StationRadioRegistry|WorkerTerminal'` PASS20 tests; after adding pending-text/bundle regressions, `--filter LiveFldigiBridgeTests` PASS15 (overlap). Swift worker compile/link and `git diff --check` pass. Fake RPC and receiver only.
findings.limits: No external fldigi, actual engine restart, RX/RF readback, hardware or process-crash qualification. RPC acknowledgment is the bounded release evidence; duty is not persisted/replayed into a potentially unrelated future external engine. Explicit emergency Stop remains available. Forced process loss still requires the external engine/operator's independent safeguards.
